rows.label: tlk70000070_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I see... So the capital was attacked,
just like Felt Village...

rows.label: tlk70000070_03_msg0002
rows.name:
We just want to live quietly.
Why did this have to happen...

rows.label: tlk70000070_03_msg0003
rows.name:
At times like this, I wish that
legendary Knight-sama were still
here...

rows.label: tlk70000070_03_msg0004
rows.name:
You don't know? Back when that old
innkeeper was still a child...

rows.label: tlk70000070_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Apparently someone from this village
held the title of knight.

rows.label: tlk70000070_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Even I have a hard time believing such
a fine Knight-sama came from a little
village like this.
